Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon with the [DS] trait unsuspends.

[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If you have 1 or more memory, your opponent adds their top security card to the hand. Then, if you have 1 or less, until your opponent's turn ends, 1 of their Digimon or Tamers can't suspend.
